annotations.title: Copy my CV into a new editable CV

description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. Copies the user's primary CV (or another of their CVs by from_cv_id) into a new editable CV on techjobs.vn (at most 5 per user on Free, 20 on Pro), optionally tailored to one job by job_id. Returns the copy's content and a link for the user to review it. The primary CV is not changed by this tool. Then use update_cv_variant to edit it, and set_primary_cv if the user wants it as their primary CV.

from_cv_id.description: Id of one of the user's other CVs to copy, from list_my_cvs. Omit to copy the primary CV.

job_id.description: Job id from search_jobs or get_job: makes a copy tailored to that job (Bản theo job).

title.description: Name of the new CV as the user sees it, e.g. "CV Backend — Grab".

name: create_cv_variant
title: Copy my CV into a new editable CV
